name: Beartic
notes: Painted design: white fur with long vertical strokes over body (island 8), arms (19, 23), ears (15) and soles (30); the face (top of island 8, UV box 140-440 x 0-430) has the same strokes but swirling around the eyes and nose; the waist tuft is many tiny islands painted as pale bluish-white facets; the beard (islands 7, 39, 42) is painted blue with sharp white wedge highlights (icicles); dark grey claws and pads, black nose plate (40), mouth (31).

So: white fur = long fur following the painted strokes, longer and softer at the island edges; face = short, flat fur (the long-fur pass made crumpled wrinkles there); waist tuft = short soft fur (tiny islands, no edge band so strands do not stop at every seam); beard = ice: glossy, low roughness, raised specular mask, only long smooth ripples along the painted icicle streaks (no cracks, no facet cells); claws, pads, nose and mouth untouched (claws a little glossier).
Body shader binds no normal (manifest normal null): in game only _dif and _par load; the gloss on the beard comes from _par (R lower, B higher).
